officialEvidence.observation: Official DLRS portal identifies a Dinajpur Zonal Settlement Office and describes survey/map services.
officialEvidence.coverage: Dinajpur district and zonal office custody

officialEvidence.observation: Official online land-record and survey system states that it displays survey-stage khatians and provides map display/search functions; displayed records may be draft and are not asserted as a complete cadastral registry.
Official land-map project describes mouza- and plot-based map-sheet digitization/georeferencing and exposes administrative selectors; no public safe parcel feature response was retained.

observedServices.observation: Anonymous map viewer loaded and referenced /js/MapSearch.js. Current configuration exposes POST workflow endpoints and parcel vector-tile paths.
Returned division metadata; Rangpur division code 080000000 was identified.
Returned Dinajpur district metadata: unit code 080700000 and component code 4151.
Returned one survey record, RS/BRS (rsnum 201901), status চলমান (ongoing).
Returned a bounded list of available survey units, but no Dinajpur Sadar unit was returned in this response; this is a coverage/service observation, not evidence of citywide absence.
Response did not yield a city-bounded parcel geometry or safe native identity; the endpoint returned a broad mouza-style listing rather than a usable Dinajpur city parcel sample.
Referenced by current JavaScript for raster/vector overlay catalog, but no tile request was made without a verified Dinajpur mouza key and no raw tile was retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: DLRS national land-record/survey service with a Dinajpur Zonal Settlement Office; the settlement viewer exposes survey/mouza workflows.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: National service custody, Dinajpur district metadata, and an ongoing RS/BRS survey route were verified. No citywide open parcel geometry/identity response was verified.
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: National/state land-record and survey custody is evidenced; local city registry accessibility and completeness remain unestablished.

qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: not ready; no safe native parcel identity response retained

blocker: The official viewer's current workflow exposed administrative survey and mouza endpoints but did not produce a bounded Dinajpur city parcel geometry plus stable native identity response suitable for retention.
remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point was not shifted and was not used as a citywide absence test. City records may exist in other survey stages, offline records, authenticated routes, or currently unexposed mouza/tile keys.
nextStep: If a later attempt is authorized, continue only through the official DLRS/settlement viewer, identify an explicitly Dinajpur Sadar mouza key, inspect its metadata and bounded response, and retain at most three full polygons with one stable native identity field.
